html:
Adding Three Numbers

You can group two addends first without changing the total. Look for a pair that makes ten, then add the remaining number.

Worked example

6 + 3 + 4 = (6 + 4) + 3 = 10 + 3 = 13. Check that all three original addends were used once.

Watch out

Reordering is useful for addition; do not apply the same shortcut to subtraction.
